# Una Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 10  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c4 P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 c14 P17](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0017)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** minister's daughter  <sub>[v5 c5 P110](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0110)</sub>

## Appearance

Una is not pretty, possessing a small, thin body, tiny hands, and a pale face with hollow eyes. She has straight, dead-black hair worn in braids that she keeps smooth as satin, and almond-shaped dark-blue eyes with a wistful, sorrowful expression. She has tiny white teeth and has never been very strong physical-wise.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 c14 P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018), [v5 c14 P38](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0038), [v5 c28 P11](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0011), [v5 c28 P12](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0012), [v5 c28 P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026), [v5 c34 P5](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0005)_

## Personality

Una is a dreamy, sweet, and timid girl who is deeply sensitive to public opinion. She is gentle, polite, compassionate, and tender-hearted, hating fighting and crying out of sympathy for others. Unlike most of her peers, she genuinely enjoys praying and is pious. Although shy and easily quailing at daunting tasks, she possesses a selfless devotion to her family, especially her father.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c8 P2](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0002), [v5 c9 P10](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0010), [v5 c17 P23](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0023), [v5 c19 P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007), [v5 c23 P4](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0004), [v5 c23 P16](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0016), [v5 c31 P13](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0013)_

## History

Una grew up in Maywater before moving with her minister father and siblings to Glen St. Mary. After befriending the Ingleside children, she helped harbor the runaway orphan Mary Vance, who taught her how to wash dishes and shared terrifying stories that shaped Una's fear of ghosts and stepmothers. When Mrs. Alec Davis attempted to adopt Una from her father, Mr. Meredith was shaken into realizing his neglect of his children. Later, during a strict self-imposed fast for the Good-Conduct Club, Una fainted during a church service, alarming her father and Dr. Gilbert Blythe. After hearing her father privately voice his anguish over his love for Rosemary West, Una bravely conquered her shyness and walked to Rosemary's house to ask her to marry her father to make him happy. Rosemary reassured Una that she would be a friend rather than a cruel stepmother.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c9 P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 c10 P21](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0021), [v5 c14 P17](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0017), [v5 c14 P36](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0036), [v5 c28 P11](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0011), [v5 c28 P16](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0016), [v5 c28 P21](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0021), [v5 c28 P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026), [v5 c30 P0](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0000), [v5 c31 P12](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0012), [v5 c33 P36](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0036), [v5 c34 P5](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0005), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)_
